title: Postcard and Garden
author: Ines Kavanagh
blurb: Xanthe Voss, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
